title: garcinia gummi-gutta
intro: Garcinia gummi-gutta, commonly known as the Malabar tamarind, is a tropical evergreen tree native to parts of Asia. It is valued for its health benefits, which include weight management, improved blood sugar control, and reduced cholesterol levels. The therapeutic actions of Garcinia gummi-gutta are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as hydroxycitric acid (HCA), which inhibits citrate lyase, an enzyme involved in fat synthesis, and also exhibits antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. Additionally, the plant's fruit, leaves, and bark contain other bioactive compounds like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, contributing to its medicinal properties.
